color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_idempotency.py
SIGKILL at questionnaire_send, restart,
assert the vendor inbox holds exactly one email

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_resume.py
kill at evidence_review, restart,
assert completed steps are a prefix and the review reaches GATED

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_armor_flow.py
run NimbusWrite, assert adversarial_conduct, Trust Score
at least 25 below baseline, band escalate — then run the
twelve-variant corpus and assert the published rate,
and zero false positives on the three clean packs

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_iam_boundaries.py
the evidence agent attempts to send email
and the gateway raises PolicyViolation

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_cross_exam.py
run DataDynamo, assert an access_control finding with
contradiction true whose evidence_ref resolves to a chunk
containing the SOC 2 exception language

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Side effects happen exactly once
across retries, restarts and redeliveries

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Recoverability is structural,
not special-case recovery code

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The defence is measured, not asserted.
Adversarial content is a trust signal rather than
a blocked request — and the detection rate is published

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Least privilege is enforced,
not merely documented

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The Evidence agent reconciles against a retrieved
passage, and can point at it

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The fleet overrules the intake form, survives
an unordered bus, and cannot forge a human decision

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2:20 · the runtime killed live,
then one email in the inbox

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p: 2:20 · the review resumes at the exact step

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1:45 · the money shot — blocked, flagged,
and the Trust Score falls 25 points
3:10 · the detection-rate table in the README

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3:10 · the IAM console filtered to the fleet,
and a test failing as designed

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1:20 · MFA claimed everywhere, contradicted by
their own SOC 2 exceptions, quoting the retrieved passage

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1:35 · the tier badge changes from 2 to 1,
with the vendor's own answer named as the reason

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center;

span.p:
scenarios/demo_runner.py runs in CI on every push
against fixtures, not live models, so it stays free — and so you never
discover on 28 August that the demo path broke on 24 August.
The corpus run is the one job worth real model calls, on a schedule

svg.text: Drawbridge — The tests, the architectural claims they defend, and what a judge watches happen
